title: Polynesian Voyaging Society Honors the 50th Anniversary of Hōkūleʻa’s 1976 Maiden Voyage to Tahiti
lineage: Retrospective account from the operating institution, not an independent navigation log. Crowd size is a reported reception, not independently established adoption. The page’s stronger claims about prehistoric settlement are not inferred from a single voyage.

passages.note: Departed Honolua Bay on 1 May 1976; navigated by Mau Piailug; arrived in Tahiti 4 June 1976; welcomed by a crowd.
